newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish repo allocates 10.5 bln SKR to market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish repo allocates 10.5 bln SKR to market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it allocated 10.5 billion crowns to the market in its weekly repurchase operation.
The one-week repo was set at an unchanged, fixed rate of 4.10 percent as expected by the market and will run from June 25 to July 2.
The operation replaces an operation that allocated six billion crowns to the market. The Riksbank said 23.03 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
